lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Terrence Villanueva is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Terrence is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Terrence Villanueva is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Terrence kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Terrence's gone." August looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Terrence." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Emilio blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Draw Fire (Level 1). In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Rally (Level 1). In the wilds, when the fight is lost and running would be sane, you look at the people standing with you and you do not run. Once per fight, when the trajectory turns hopeless and an ally stands beside you, you hold the line instead of fleeing. Not volume — a promise kep
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Shield Wall (Level 1). Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Terrence Villanueva, 41 days. The mantle passes to Emilio Healy.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Emilio Healy, 38 — a Firefighter. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, War Cry.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Terrence — and Terrence is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, August, Oscar, Sofia and 5 more speak for Emilio — "Terrence trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Emilio before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
